raw_segments.text: This opinion of inspiration, called commonly, private spirit, begins very often, from some
lucky finding of an error generally held by others, and not knowing or not remembering
by what conduct of reason they came to so singular a truth, as they think it though
it be many times an untruth they light on, they presently admire themselves, as being
in the special grace of God Almighty, who hath revealed the same to them supernaturally
